name: software-dev-agent
description: Reorganized software development agent with 3 core skills: create-task, generate-plan, execute-task

skills.name: Create Task
skills.description: Create development tasks with status=pending (must specify projectKey). Does NOT auto-generate plans - decoupled from planning step.

skills.name: Generate Plan
skills.description: Generate plan files for pending tasks. Processes all pending tasks or specific taskId. Creates docs/plan-{taskId}.md files and updates status to planned.

skills.name: Execute Task
skills.description: Execute planned tasks with configurable backend (Claude or Cursor). Transitions status: planned → developing → reviewing → done/failed.

skills.name: Start Agent in Tmux
skills.description: Start an agent (ccr/claude/cursor) in a tmux session for background execution. Auto-resolves project path and plan file. Use when user wants to run a task with tmux or background agent.

skills.name: Agent Status
skills.description: Query agent status from tmux sessions. Returns pane status, last output lines, and task info. Use when user asks if agent is running or wants to check progress.

skills.name: Stop Agent
skills.description: Stop an agent running in a tmux session. Sends Ctrl+C (graceful) or force kills the pane. Updates task status to failed.

skills.name: Open Agent in iTerm
skills.description: Open iTerm2 and switch to the tmux session for a running agent. Triggered when user wants to view agent progress in terminal. Can be called from app via WebSocket.

ccr.name: CCR (Claude Code Runner)
ccr.description: Run ccr code run --agent --dangerously-skip-permissions plan-based-code-generator < planPath. Preferred for tmux-based execution.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.description: Use Claude Code CLI for development via openclaw-integration.js

cursor.name: Cursor CLI
cursor.description: Use Cursor CLI for development via openclaw-integration.js
